headline: Panama President Aims for Mercosur Membership Before 2030
summary: Panamá President José Raúl Mulino announced his goal to join the Mercosur trade bloc before his term ends in 2030, targeting deeper agricultural, investment, and energy integration.
why: Expanding Mercosur to Central America would connect South American agricultural and energy producers with Panamá's international canal, banking, and logistics hub.
